action_items: Mobile /app/mobile/src/components/tools/ProviderPriceChecker.tsx line 251: add `tone="teal"` prop to the StatCard for 'You are charged' so it picks up primary/surface accent (StatCard tone map already exists at line 379-384).

critical_code_review_comments: ProviderPriceChecker.tsx (mobile) StatCard tone system is defined but the two callers that need it (pc-stat-charged, pc-range) don't pass `tone` — silent regression.

ProviderPriceChecker.tsx StatCard `toneMap.teal.bg = colors.surface` is a code smell: it's identical to the default fallback, so even if `tone="teal"` were passed the card would still look identical to the untoned one. Should be `colors.tealSoft` or a tinted alpha of primary.
BudgetCalculatorTool.tsx bc-supplements uses colors.goldSoft/colors.gold consistently — clean.
ClassificationSelfCheck.tsx: csc-current-prefilled hint copy 'Prefilled from Mum. Change it if it's out of date.' is clear + plain-English — good parity with web.

rca of the issue: Root cause of mobile PC card parity: StatCard component accepts a `tone` prop and has a toneMap for teal/sage/clay (lines 379-384). However, the two direct StatCard callers for pc-stat-charged (line 251) and pc-range (lines 254/256) don't pass the tone prop, so both fall through to the default `{accent: colors.border, bg: colors.surface}` — resulting in identical plain grey cards. Only pc-your-share is rendered via a separate ShareCard component (lines 394-412) which correctly hard-codes goldSoft + gold. Fix: pass `tone="teal"` and `tone="sage"` in the two StatCard invocations, AND update toneMap.teal.bg from `colors.surface` (default) to a teal-tinted token so the visual differentiation actually shows.
